Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は

【Full Story】
On August 16, at Mazda Stadium, Hanshin took control of the game almost immediately.

In the first inning, Teruaki Sato hit a two-run home run to center field. Hanshin led 2-0 before the game had settled.

Starting pitcher Ryoto Ihara gave that lead a strong base. He worked five innings, allowing only two hits and one run.

Hiroshima’s run came in the fifth inning. Elehuris Montero hit a solo home run, making the score 2-1. But that was Hiroshima’s only run all night.

Hanshin added more runs in the seventh and eighth innings. The advantage grew, and the game moved away from a close finish.

The final score was Hiroshima 1, Hanshin 8.

It was a win that began with one powerful swing and finished through steady work on both sides of the game.

【Point One】
Hanshin’s late offense came from more than the opening home run. Seishiro Sakamoto drove in a run in the seventh and another in the eighth. Pinch-hitter Fushimi also added an RBI in the seventh. The victory grew step by step, rather than being decided by one early moment alone.

【Point Two】
The result shows that Hiroshima did not produce a sustained scoring rally. Its only run came from a solo home run, with no larger inning following it. But the available facts do not show whether that control came from the relief pitchers, the defense, or a specific change after Ihara left. The safe conclusion is about the score, not one exact method.
